vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species plasmodium_falciparum --assembly GCA000002765v3 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the three sequences the records sit on (Pf3D7_05_v3, Pf3D7_API_v3 and Pf3D7_MIT_v3) at their full length from the per-sequence files Plasmodium_falciparum.GCA000002765v3.dna.primary_assembly.<sequence>.fa.gz of Ensembl Protists (release 63 of Ensembl Genomes), every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 261 records, 188 on chromosome 5 (Pf3D7_05_v3; 14 of them name it by the cache's synonyms MAL5 and Pf3D7_05), 45 on the apicoplast Pf3D7_API_v3 and 28 on the mitochondrion Pf3D7_MIT_v3. 252 come from the seeded generator tools/vep-seeded-variants (seed 1, 24 records a category, on those three sequences, every reference allele read from the genome sequence), their IDs the generator's category and ordinal. 9 are designed records (code4_made_codon_1 to code4_made_codon_9): in each of the mitochondrion's three coding transcripts, the first codon one substitution from the codon genetic code table 4 translates unlike the standard code, changed once so that the residue stays, once so that it alters and once at the stop codon, each reference base read from the genome sequence and held to the cached coding sequence. Two exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, six per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name: every generator record at a sequence's first and last base, the first eight of every other generator category and the nine designed records. The cache names no known variant, so no record carries a variation identifier. The generator wrote no record across an origin (the cache flags neither organelle circular), none in a codon table 4 reads unlike the standard code (the mitochondrion's coding sequences hold none) and one between genes. The apicoplast translates under genetic code table 11 and the mitochondrion under table 4, each transcript's codon_table in the cache
